spans.s:
व्यत्, अन्, अती, अत्, going, moving, &c., (Sāy.
व्यन्तः = गच्छन्तः, Ṛg-veda
व्यत् व्यत्. See under rt. 1. वी, p. 953.
व्य 1. व्य, अस्, m. (fr. rt. व्ये), a coverer.

व्य 2. व्य (contracted fr. अव्यय), a techni-
cal symbol for indeclinables such as नि, चित्, स्वर्, &c.

व्यंश व्य्-अंश, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vi-
pracitti.

व्यंस व्य्-अंस, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. without a
shoulder, shoulderless, mutilated, (Sāy. = विगतांस-
छिन्न-बाहु); (अस्), m., N. of a Rākṣasa.
व्य्-अंशक, अस्, m. a mountain.
व्य्-अंसक, अस्, m. a cheat, rogue, juggler.

व्यंशुक व्य्-अंशुक, अस्, आ, अम्, without a
garment, undressed, naked.

व्यंस् व्य्-अंस् (वि-अंस्), cl. 10. P. -अंसयति,
-यितुम्, to divide asunder, divide; to render useless
or harmless, foil, ward off; to deceive.
व्य्-अंसन, अम्, n. cheating, tricking, deceiving.
व्य्-अंसनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deceived or cheated.

व्य्-अंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, tricked, deceived, cheated;
disappointed in one's expectations.
व्यक्त व्य्-अक्त, व्य्-अक्ति. See col. 2.

व्य्-अक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned, decorated, hand-
some, beautiful (Ved.); caused to appear, manifested,
developed, manifest, apparent, evident, specifically
known or understood; specified, distinguished; spe-
cific, individual; wise, learned; (अस्), m. ‘the mani-
fested,’ epithet of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. ‘the discrete or
discernible,’ that which is developed as the product
of अ-व्यक्त, q. v. (in the Sāṅkhya philosophy);
(अम्), ind. manifestly, evidently, clearly, certainly.
—व्यक्त-गणित, अम्, n. calculation with known
numbers, arithmetic.
—व्यक्त-ता, f. or व्यक्त-त्व,
अम्, n. distinctness, manifestation.
—व्यक्त-तारक,
अस्, आ, अम्, having clear stars.
—व्यक्त-दृष्टार्थ
(˚ट-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, perceiving or witnessing a
transaction with one's own eyes, any one present as
an eye-witness, a witness (in general).
—व्यक्त-
भुज्, क्, क्, क्, consuming everything manifested or
all visible things (said of time).
—व्यक्त-राशि, इस्,
f. (in arithmetic) known or absolute quantity.
—व्यक्-
त-रूप, अस्, m. ‘having a manifested form,’ epithet
of Viṣṇu.
—व्यक्त-रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having a
discernible shape.
—व्यक्त-लक्ष्मन्, आ, आ, अ,
having evident signs, having clear marks, clearly
characterised.
—व्यक्त-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, dis-
playing valour.
—व्यक्ती-करण, अम्, n. the act of
making manifest or clear or distinct.
—व्यक्ती-कृ,
cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make
manifest, make clear or distinct.
—व्यक्ती-कृत, अस्,
आ, अम्, made clear or manifest, made distinct.
—व्यक्ती-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to
become clearly visible, be distinct or clear.
—व्यक्ती-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become clearly visible, distinct,
clear.
—व्यक्तोदित (˚त-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, spoken
clearly or plainly.

व्यक्ष् व्य्-अक्ष् (वि-अक्ष्), cl. 1. 5. P. -अक्षति,
-अक्ष्णोति, &c. = व्य्-अश्, to pervade, &c.

व्यक्ष व्य्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (in astronomy)
having no latitude; [cf. निर्-अक्ष.]

व्यग्र व्य्-अग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered, per-
plexed, distracted; agitated, alarmed, frightened;
zealous, eager, eagerly engaged in, occupied, zealously
occupied; (अस्), m., N. of Viṣṇu.
—व्यग्र-ता,
f. or व्यग्र-त्व, अम्, n. perplexedness, perplexity,
confusion, anxiety; zealous occupation, zeal.
—व्य-
ग्र-पुरन्ध्रि-वर्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having compa-
nies of matrons zealously occupied.
—व्यग्र-मनस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, perplexed or bewildered in mind.

व्यङ्ग व्य्-अङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, limbless, de-
formed, mutilated; lamed, lame; bodiless; ill-
arranged; (अस्), m. a cripple; a frog; discoloration
of the face, dark spots on the cheek.
—व्यङ्ग-
त्व, अम्, n. mutilation; the state of a cripple,
maimedness.
—व्यङ्गार्थ (˚ग-अर्˚), अस्, m. (in
rhetoric) suggested sense or meaning.

व्यङ्गय, Nom. P. व्यङ्गयति, -यितुम्, to
mutilate, maim, cripple.

व्यङ्गार व्य्-अङ्गार, अस्, आ, अम्, without char-
coal, having no fire, (व्यङ्गारे, at the time when
the burning charcoal is extinguished.)

व्यङ्गुल व्य्-अङ्गुल, अम्, n. the sixtieth part
of an Aṅgula.

व्यच् 1. व्यच् (probably connected with
2. व्य्-अच्), cl. 6. P. विचति, विव्याच, व्य-
चिष्यति, अव्यचीत् or अव्याचीत्, व्यचितुम्, to cheat,
trick, defraud, deceive; to encompass, embrace, sur-
round (Ved.); to pervade, contain (Ved.): Caus. व्या-
चयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अविव्यचत्: Desid. विव्यचि-
षति: Intens. वेविच्यते, वाव्यचीति or वाव्यक्ति.

व्यच् 2. व्य्-अच् or व्य्-अञ्च् (वि-अच्), cl. 1. P. A.
-अचति, -अञ्चति, -ते, -अञ्चितुम्, Ved. to force or bend
asunder, sunder, separate; to make wide, extend.

व्यचस्, अस्, n., Ved. anything which is expanded
or spread, (Sāy. = व्याप्तम् अन्तरिक्षम्); expanse,
amplitude, vastness, (Sāy. = व्यापन.)
—व्यचस्-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. expansive, (Sāy. = व्याप्ति-
मत्, Ṛg-veda

); (according to some) emu-
lous, (see Ṛg-veda
, Nirukta
VIII. 10

व्यचिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. expanding every-
where, extending far and wide.

व्य्-अच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being widened, being
extended.

व्यज् व्य्-अज् (वि-अज्), cl. 1. P. -अजति, -अजितुम्,
Ved. to throw in various directions, toss about, move
to and fro.
व्य्-अज, अस्, m. a fan (= व्य्-अजन).

व्याज व्य्-आज, अस्, m. (fr. व्य्-अज्), deceit,
deception, fraud, craft, art, cunning; disguise (either
of purpose or of person); semblance, appearance,
pretext, pretence (sometimes at the end of comps.,
e. g. मृगया-व्याजेन, under the pretext of hunt-
ing); contrivance, means; wickedness.
—व्याज-
निन्दा, f. ‘artful censure,’ a particular figure of
rhetoric (praise veiled under apparent censure);
ironical praise.
—व्याज-भानु-जित्, त्, m. a proper
N.
—व्याज-स्तुति, इस्, f. ‘artful praise,’ indirect
eulogy, praise or censure conveyed in language that
expresses the contrary (as when from blame praise
is expressed, and when from praise blame); ironical
commendation.
—व्याजी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c.,
to hold out as a pretence or pretext.
—व्याजी-कृत्य,
ind. having held out as a pretext, having pretended
(= अपदिश्य).
—व्याजोक्ति (˚ज-उक्˚), इस्, f. covert
allusion (intended to mislead), innuendo.

व्य्-अजन, अम्, n. a palm-leaf or other substance
used as a fan, a fan (in general).

व्यञ्ज् व्य्-अञ्ज् (वि-अञ्ज्), cl. 7. P. A. -अनक्ति,
अङ्क्ते, -अङ्क्तुम् or -अञ्जितुम्, to anoint thoroughly
(Ved.); to decorate, adorn, make beautiful or hand-
some (A., Ved.); to cause to appear, develop, mani-
fest; to discriminate, make clear: Pass. -अज्यते, to
be manifested or developed; to be expressed: Caus.
-अञ्जयति, -यितुम्, to cause to appear, make clearly
visible or manifest.

व्य्-अक्ति, इस्, f. visible appearance or manifestation,
making clear or evident, clearness, distinctness, dis-
cernibility, discrimination; specific appearance or
variation, individuality; a person, an individual (op-
posed to जाति), variety; gender (in gram.); case,
inflection, the proper form of any inflected word;
a vowel (?).
—व्यक्ति-ता, f. or व्यक्ति-त्व, अम्, n.
distinctness, individuality, personality.

व्य्-अङ्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be indicated correctly,
to be intimated by sarcastic allusions or insinuations
(applied to figurative or poetical speech, allusive lan-
guage or insinuation, sarcasm, covert expression of
suspicion or contempt, &c.).
—व्यङ्ग्योक्ति (˚य-
उक्˚), इस्, f. covert language, sarcastic insinuation.

व्य्-अञ्जक, अस्, इका, अम्, making clear, clearly
showing, manifesting, indicating, denoting, declar-
ing; (अस्), m. external indication of passion or feel-
ing, gesture, dramatic action; feeling; a sign, mark,
symbol; figurative expression or insinuation.
—व्यञ्-
जक-त्व, अम्, n. the containing figurative or allusive
expressions, indication by covert insinuations or ellip-
tical language.
—व्यञ्जकार्थ (˚क-अर्˚), अस्, m.
(in rhetoric) a suggestive or significant sense.

व्य्-अञ्जन, अम्, n. the act of making clear, mark-
ing, distinguishing, indicating; a consonant (as mark-
ing or distinguishing sound); a mark, spot, sign,
token; insignia, paraphernalia; a mark or sign of
puberty; the beard; mark of sex or gender, a privy
part (male or female); anything used in dressing or
preparing food, anything mixed with food, seasoning,
sauce, condiment; a limb, member (= अव-यव);
day, = दिन; (अम्, आ), n. f. figurative expression or
[]
insinuation; irony, sarcasm; (आ), f. the third power
of a word, suggestion.
—व्यञ्जन-सङ्गम, अस्,
m. a collection or group of consonants.
—व्यञ्जन-
सन्धि, इस्, m. the junction of consonants (in gram-
mar).
—व्यञ्जन-सन्निपात, अस्, m. the falling
together or conjunction of consonants.
—व्यञ्जन-
स्थाने, ind. in the place of condiment, as seasoning.
—व्यञ्जना-वृत्ति, इस्, f. figurative or elliptical
style.
—व्यञ्जनोदय (˚न-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, fol-
lowed by a consonant.
—व्यञ्जनोपध (˚न-उप्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, preceded by a consonant.

व्य्-अञ्जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making clearly visible
or manifest.

व्य्-अञ्जिजिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to make clearly
visible, trying to make manifest, wishing to detect
or expose, &c.

व्य्-अञ्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, clearly manifested or made
visible, distinguished, marked, characterised.
—व्यञ्-
जित-वृत्ति-भेद, अस्, आ, अम्, having varying actions
manifested.

व्यडम्बक व्यडम्बक or व्यडम्बन or
व्यडम्बर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. अड् with
वि), the castor-oil plant, Ricinus Communis.

व्यतिकृ व्य्-अति-कृ (वि-अति-), cl. 8. A. -कु-
रुते, &c., to act mutually or reciprocally: Pass.
-क्रियते, to be greatly changed or moved.

व्यतिकॄ व्य्-अति-कॄ (वि-अति-), Pass. -कीर्यते,
&c., to be scattered in different directions; to be
mixed together.

1. व्य्-अतिकर, अस्, आ, अम्, acting reciprocally, acting
on or with one another, reciprocal; pervading,
spreading through or over; contiguous to, in contact
with; (अस्), m. reciprocal action, reciprocity, mutual
relation, exchange, interchange; contact, contiguity,
union; alternation; action (in general); obstruction,
hindrance, reverse, misfortune, calamity; opportunity.

2. व्य्-अतिकर, अस्, m. a scattering in different
directions, mixing or blending together, mixture.
व्य्-अतिकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, pervaded.

व्य्-अतिकीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, scattered about in dif-
ferent directions, mixed together.

व्यतिक्रम् व्य्-अति-क्रम् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. A.
-क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go or pass by,
pass over or beyond; to elapse, be spent (said of
time); to step over, transgress, offend against; to
excel, surpass, conquer; to neglect, omit, violate,
forget; to apply one's self to anything (acc.) in a
wrong manner.

व्य्-अतिक्रम, अस्, m. passing over or beyond,
transgressing, deviating; violating, non-performance,
disregard, neglect, breach, (संविदो व्यतिक्रमः,
violation or breach of a contract); inverted order,
inversion, reverse, contrariety, opposition, the con-
trary of anything, the contrary of right, crime, vice,
fault, sin; the contrary of prosperity, adversity, mis-
fortune.

व्य्-अतिक्रमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, passing over, deviating,
transgressing.

व्य्-अतिक्रम्य, ind. having passed over or beyond,
having transgressed or violated; having disregarded
or neglected.

व्य्-अतिक्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, passed over; gone by,
elapsed; transgressed, violated, retracted; neglected,
disregarded; reversed, inverted.

व्यतिगम् व्य्-अति-गम् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -गच्-
छति, -गन्तुम्, to go or pass by, to be spent (as
time).
व्य्-अतिगत, अस्, आ, अम्, passed by, elapsed.

व्यतिगा व्य्-अति-गा (वि-अति-), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति,
गातुम्, to pass by.

व्यतिचर् व्य्-अति-चर् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. (ep.
also A.) -चरति (-ते), -चरितुम्, to transgress against,
commit an offence against, offend.

व्यतिचुम्ब् व्य्-अति-चुम्ब् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P.
[]
-चुम्बति, -चुम्बितुम्, to kiss or touch closely, be
in immediate contact with.

व्य्-अतिचुम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, touching closely, in
immediate contact with.

व्यतिजल्प् व्य्-अति-जल्प् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P.
-जल्पति, -जल्पितुम्, to chatter together, gossip, talk
with one another.

व्यतिजि व्य्-अति-जि (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. A.
-जयति, -ते, -जेतुम्, to overcome, surpass, excel.

व्यतितन् व्य्-अति-तन् (वि-अति-), cl. 8. A. -त-
नुते, -तनितुम्, to extend mutually, vie with each
other in extending or spreading out.

व्यतितॄ व्य्-अति-तॄ (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -तरति,
-तरितुम् or -तरीतुम्, to pass completely across, pass
over successfully, overcome.

व्यतिनी व्य्-अति-नी (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -नयति,
&c., Ved. to allow to pass away.

व्यतिभा व्य्-अति-भा (वि-अति-), cl. 2. A. -भाते,
-बभे, to shine forth fully or brightly (used imper-
sonally).

व्यतिभू व्य्-अति-भू (वि-अति-), cl. 1. A. -भ-
वते, &c., to vie with any one (acc.), contend for
precedence or superiority.

व्यतिमर्श व्य्-अतिमर्श (वि-अति-), अस्, m. (in
Vedic ritual) a particular kind of विहार, q. v., (it is
described as the mutual transposition of the several
Pādas or half verses or whole verses of the first and
second Vālakhilya hymns which are repeated in sets,
two being always taken together.)

व्य्-अतिमर्शम्, ind., Ved. having skipped or
passed over, having missed or taken alternately, alter-
nating.

व्यतिमुह् व्य्-अति-मुह् (वि-अति-), cl. 4. P. -मुह्-
यति, &c., to be excessively perplexed or embarrassed.

व्य्-अतिमूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively perplexed
or embarrassed, utterly distracted.

व्यतिया व्य्-अति-या (वि-अति-), cl. 2. P. -याति,
यातुम्, to go completely through, penetrate, per-
vade (with acc., Ved.); to pass by, flow on (as
time).
व्य्-अतियात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone by, passed, spent.

व्यतियु व्य्-अति-यु (वि-अति-), cl. 2. P., 9. P. A.
-यौति, -युनाति, -युनीते, -यवितुम्, to join with
one another, unite mutually, mix together, inter-
mingle.

व्यतिरा व्य्-अति-रा (वि-अति-), cl. 2. A. -राते,
व्य्-अत्य्-अरे, see Pāṇ.

व्यतिरिच् व्य्-अति-रिच् (वि-अति-), Pass. -रिच्यते,
to reach far beyond, leave behind, surpass, excel (with
abl. or acc.); to be separated from, differ from, deviate.

व्य्-अतिरिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reaching beyond, passing
or projecting beyond, surpassing, excelling, excessive,
immoderate; separate, different from, distinct from:
excepted; withdrawn, withheld; (अम्), ind. with
the exception of, except, without (e. g. स्वर-व्˚,
except the accent).

व्य्-अतिरेक, अस्, m. reaching or passing beyond, ex-
celling, excellence; separation from, distinction, differ-
ence, separateness, deviation; exception, exclusion,
negation, interception; contrariety, contrast, dissimili-
tude, a particular figure in rhetoric or poetry (the con-
trasting of things compared in some respects with each
other); logical discontinuance (opposed to अन्वय),
negative inference; (एण), ind. with exception of,
without; (ए), ind. on the contrary supposition.
—व्य-
तिरेक-व्याप्ति, इस्, f. ‘pervasion of difference or
dissimilitude,’ a comprehensive argument derived
from negation or non-existence of certain qualities.
—व्यतिरेकालङ्कार (˚क-अल्˚), अस्, m. the rheto-
rical figure called Vyatireka, (see above.)

व्य्-अतिरेकिन्, ई, इणी, इ, passing beyond, excelling,
distinguishing, discriminating; excepting; different,
reverse.
—व्यतिरेकि-लिङ्ग, अम्, n. an exclusive
mark, i. e. a negative property (which excludes its
[]
subject from the class possessing the corresponding
positive property).
—व्यतिरेक्य्-उदाहरण, अम्, n.
illustration by contrast or negation (of certain pro-
perties).

व्यतिरुह् व्य्-अति-रुह् (वि-अति-), cl. 1. P. -रो-
हति, -रोढुम्, to pass into various states of being,
attain to or obtain another (state): Caus. -रोपयति
or -रोहयति, -यितुम्, to eject, expel, remove, dis-
possess.

व्य्-अतिरोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, ejected, displaced, ex-
pelled, ousted, dispossessed, removed from rightful
possession.

व्यतिलङ्घिन् व्य्-अतिलङ्घिन्, ई, इनी, इ, passing
or falling away from, slipping away.

व्यतिलू व्य्-अति-लू (वि-अति-), cl. 9. A. -लुनीते

fested, displayed, exhibited.

moved or got rid of; having passed through a place,

व्य्-अपोह्य. See under व्य्-अप-वह्.

or given up.

व्य्-अपविद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces,
thrown about in confusion, cast away, rejected, dis-
carded.
—व्यपविद्ध-वृषी-मठ, अस्, आ, अम्,
whose (ascetic) seats and cells were discarded or
abandoned.

व्यपसृज् व्य्-अप-सृज् (वि-अप-), cl. 6. P.
-सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्, to let go; to send away, dismiss,
throw away, relinquish, abandon.

व्यपसृप् व्य्-अप-सृप् (वि-अप-), cl. 1. P.
-सर्पति, -सर्प्तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to go away, creep
away, run away, escape.

-हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to take away, carry away,
remove; to cut off.

व्यपाकृति व्य्-अपाकृति, इस्, f. driving away,
repelling, denial.

व्यपाश्रि व्य्-अपा-श्रि (वि-अप-आ-), cl. 1. P.
A. -श्रयति, -ते, -श्रयितुम्, to go to for refuge,

व्य्-अपाश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has taken
refuge with, relying upon, trusting to.

व्य्-अपाश्रित्य, ind. having gone to for refuge,
having taken refuge with.

व्यपे व्य्-अपे (वि-अप-इ), cl. 2. P. -अपैति,

or separated, separate; to go away, leave, depart,
leave off, cease, stop.

व्य्-अपेत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone apart or asunder,
severed, separated; gone off or away, passed away,
departed, got rid of; opposed to, contrary.
—व्य-
पेत-कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, having taint or guilt
removed.
—व्यपेत-धैर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has abandoned firmness.

—व्यपेत-हर्-

pecting; expectant, waiting, attentive; regarding,
minding; (आ), f. looking for, expectation; regard,
consideration; mutual expectation or regard; mutual
connection or relation; application, use; (in gram-
mar) the mutual application of two rules.
व्य्-अपेक्षा, f. See व्य्-अपेक्ष.

व्य्-अपेक्षण, अम्, n. the act of looking for,
expecting, expectation.

व्य्-अपेक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked for or
expected.

व्य्-अपेक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking about for,
looking round, expecting.

व्य्-अपेक्षितव्य or व्य्-अपेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be looked for or expected.

व्यपोह् व्य्-अपोह् (वि-अप-ऊह्), cl. 1. P. -अपो-

व्य्-अपोह, अस्, m. driving away, keeping off,
destroying.

chapter of the Liṅga-Purāṇa.

व्य्-अपोहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away, remov-
ing; putting out, extinguishing.

to go away, depart or deviate from; to go astray;
to go wrong, fail, miscarry; to go beyond, trans-
gress, exceed, surpass (with acc.).

व्य्-अभिचार, अस्, m. going or departing from,
wandering away, going astray, deviation, leaving or
abandoning (the right way), following improper
courses, doing what is prohibited or wicked; erring,
straying, error, trespass, transgression, crime, vice,

sin, profligacy, adultery, infidelity of a wife, &c.;

reasoning, the presence of the हेतु without the

irregularity, anomaly.

sequence of straying or erring; (in phil.) from the Vya-
bhicāra involved in the other supposition.
—व्यभि-
चार-ता, f. or व्यभिचार-त्व, अम्, n. error.

passing, deviating from (virtue), following or doing
what is improper; profligate, wanton; untrue, false;
irregular, anomalous; (a word) having a non-primi-
tive or secondary meaning, having several meanings;
(इणी), f. a wanton woman, unchaste wife, adulteress;
(इ), n. anything transitory, a transitory feeling or
state, (opposed to स्थायि, ‘a lasting state,’ q. v., and

bhāvas are said to be thirty-four in number, viz.

haustion, emaciation; 3. शङ्का, apprehension;

fatigue; 7. आलस्य, indolence, languor; 8. दैन्य,
indigence, distress; 9. चिन्ता, anxious reflection or
thought; 10. मोह, perplexity, distraction; 11.
स्मृति, recollection, effort to remember; 12. धृति,
calm enjoyment, satisfaction of mind; 13. व्रीडा,

ness; 15. हर्ष, joy, delight; 16. आवेग, flurry;

गर्व, pride, arrogance; 19. विषाद, depression,
despair; 20. औत्सुक्य, regret, eager longing; 21.
निद्रा, drowsiness; 22. अपस्मार, possession by

बोध, waking; 25. अमर्ष, angry impatience;
26. अवहित्था, dissimulation; 27. उग्रता, cruelty,
rage; 28. मति, mental perception or conclusion;
29. उपालम्भ, reviling, railing; 30. व्याधि, sick-
ness; 31. उन्माद, madness, delirium; 32. मरण,
death; 33. त्रास, fear; 34. वितर्क, doubt, delibera-
tion.)
—व्यभिचारि-ता, f. or व्यभिचारि-त्व, अम्,
n. the state of going astray, error, doubt; (in gram-
mar) the having a secondary meaning, the having
several meanings.
—व्यभिचारि-भाव, अस्, m. a
transitory state (of mind or body; see above).

व्यभ्र व्य्-अभ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, unclouded, cloud-
less.

व्याययति or व्यापयति, वेपयति (rather to be re-
ferred to rts. व्यप्, 1. विप्), -यितुम्, to throw, cast.

व्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, mutable, liable to change or
decay [cf. अ-व्˚]; (अस्), m. disappearance, loss; perish-
ing, decaying, decay, destruction, change, downfall,
decline, misfortune; spending, expenditure, expense,
outlay, disbursement, (opposed to आय, income);
squandering, extravagance, waste, prodigality; N. of
Pradhāna; N. of the twentieth (or fifty-fourth) year

station or house from the Lagna (= लग्नाद् द्वा-
दश-स्थानम्).

averse from expenditure, parsimonious.
—व्यय-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing waste or decay, &c.;
changeful, imperfect, incomplete.
—व्यय-शील, अस्,
आ, अम्, disposed to prodigality, wasteful, spendthrift.
—व्ययी-करण, अम्, n. the act of expending or
disbursing, wasting.

pended, spent, wasted, lavished.

clined, fallen into decay.

prodigal, lavish, extravagant; declining, falling into
calamity, wasting, changing, decaying, (उदय-
व्ययिन्, rising and falling.)
—व्ययि-ता, f. or व्ययि-
त्व, अम्, n. prodigality, wastefulness.

), gone away, gone; oppressed, pained, dis-
tressed; asked.

able, fruitless, ineffectual, vain; unmeaning.

profitableness, (व्यर्थ-तां या or गम्, to become

sense.

efforts.

n. unprofitableness, uselessness.

दितुम्, Ved. to go or move away, to flow away; to
oppress, harass, pain: Caus. -अर्दयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to be scattered or dissolved, destroy, annihilate.

down or away from, tear away, alienate.

रति, -करितुम्, -करीतुम्, to scatter or pour down,

mutual abuse; abuse, reviling (in general).

व्य्-अवगाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, dived or plunged into,

व्य्-अवगाह्य, ind. having plunged into.

व्यवग्रह् व्य्-अव-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति,
गृह्णीते, &c., -ग्रहीतुम्, Ved. to bring down, to
bend or incline down.

व्य्-अवगृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. brought down,
bent down.

P. A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to cut off or in
pieces, separate, separate from; to tear asunder, open,

larized, specified; distinct; interrupted, (अ-व्यवच्-

sion, determination; a division, section; letting fly

izing.

व्य्-अवदाय, having cut in two or divided.

व्यवदॄ व्य्-अव-दॄ (वि-अव-), Pass. -दीर्यते,
to be torn asunder; to burst asunder, split in two.

व्य्-अवदीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, burst asunder, broken
to pieces, distracted.

व्यवदै व्य्-अव-दै (वि-अव-), Pass. -दायते,

der; to put or place between, interpose; to separate,

ness, occupation; a difficult passage or impassable
defile, any difficulty.
—व्यायाम-शील, अस्, आ, अम्,
accustomed to exertion or exercise, fond of taking
exercise, active, robust, athletic.

व्यायामिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to exercise or
exertion, gymnastic, athletic.

व्यायामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking exercise, undergoing
fatigue, active, athletic.

व्य्-आयाम्य, ind. having made exertion or effort,
having taken exercise, having practised gymnastics,
having made to undergo exercise or exertion.

व्यायुज् व्य्-आ-युज् (वि-आ-), cl. 7. P. A. -यु-
नक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to disunite, separate, part,
become disunited.
व्य्-आयुज्य, ind. having disjoined or separated.

व्य्-आयोग, अस्, m. a kind of dramatic representa-
tion or composition in one act (belonging to the
Prakaraṇa class, and describing some military or heroic
exploit in which no part of the interest is derived
from female participation, the sentiment of love being
thereby excluded).

व्यारब्ध व्य्-आ-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. रभ्
with आ and वि), Ved. held on every side, upheld,
maintained, properly carried into effect.

vicious; (अस्), m. a villain, cheat, rogue; a snake;
a beast of prey; a tiger; a hunting leopard; a

of the Daṇḍaka metre; (ई), f. a female snake;
[cf. Old Germ. and Angl. Sax. al.]
—व्याल-खड्ग,

व्यालक, अस्, m. a vicious elephant.

व्यालम्ब् व्य्-आ-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते, -लम्-
बितुम्, to hang down; to stay behind, linger, delay.

व्य्-आलम्ब, अस्, m. the red Ricinus or castor-oil
plant.
व्य्-आलम्ब; add — hanging down, pendulous.

व्यालिख् व्य्-आ-लिख् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. -लिखति,
-लेखितुम्, to scratch or scrape against, rub against,
touch, graze; to make an incision, scratch, draw
lines, write.

व्य्-आलिखत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, scratching, scrap-
ing, piercing; touching, grazing, extending to; draw-
ing lines, delineating.

व्यालीन व्य्-आलीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ली with
आ and वि), clinging or sticking close together, cluster-
ing, dense, thick.

to stir about, agitate.

व्य्-आलोडित, अस्, आ, अम्, = मथित, stirred about,
agitated.

व्यालुप् व्य्-आ-लुप् (वि-आ-), cl. 6. P. -लुम्पति,
-लोप्तुम्, to take away, carry off, remove: Pass.
[]
-लुप्यते, to be broken asunder or destroyed, be
divided, be removed, to disappear.

-लुनीते, -लवितुम्, to cut off, cut away.

व्य्-आलून, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off.
—व्यालून-मूर्-
धज, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has the hair cut off.

quivering, tremulous, shaking, waving.

locks of hair.

अव, आ, and वि), mutual abuse or imprecation.

, is for

व्य्-आवर्ण्य, ind. having narrated in detail.
व्यावर्त व्य्-आवर्त. See col. 3.

व्य्-आवर्त, अस्, m. separating from, selecting, revo-
lution, going round; encompassing, surrounding, en-
closing; ruptured navel, umbilical hernia (= नाभि-
कण्टक).

व्यावल्ग् व्य्-आ-वल्ग् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -वल्-

व्य्-आवृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing or hiding
one's self.

आवृत्त); uncovered, opened, (in this sense वि is
rather privative.)

व्य्-आवृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, separated or singled out
from; excluded, excepted, free from (with inst.);
opened, split asunder; turned away from, turned back,
returned, desisted, desisting, ceased; turned round, re-
volved; encompassed, surrounded; fenced, screened,
(probably for व्य्-आवृत); praised, hymned (?).
—व्या-
वृत्त-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, turned back from a course,
desisting from any course of action.
—व्यावृत्त-
त्व, अम्, n. the being separated or excluded from,
&c.; the being non-extensive, (defined to be
अल्प-देश-वृत्तित्वम्, the existing in few places,
i. e. comprising but few individuals, said of a species
in relation to its genus; opposed to अधिक-देश-
वृत्तित्वम्, the characteristic of a genus viewed in
relation to the species it contains.)
—व्यावृत्त-देह,
अस्, आ, अम्, having the body severed or split asunder.
—व्यावृत्त-बुद्धि, इस्, f. ‘limited conception,’ the
conception of a class denoting few individuals, i. e. of
a class contained in a higher class.
—व्यावृत्त-शिरस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, having the head turned round.

व्य्-आवृति, इस्, f. covering, screening; exclusion;
[cf. व्य्-आवृत्ति.]

व्य्-आवृत्ति, इस्, f. separation from, selecting, selec-
tion, choice, (perhaps for व्य्-आवृति); exception, ex-
clusion, rejection; turning away; rolling back; roll-
ing round, surrounding; screening, (perhaps for व्य्-
आवृति); praise, eulogium.

1. व्य्-आवृत्य, ind. having covered over; having
obstructed or stopped.

2. व्य्-आवृत्य, ind. having separated from, having
parted with (with inst.), having turned or rolled
away, having turned back.

व्यावृज् व्य्-आ-वृज् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -वर्जति,
&c., -वर्जितुम्, to exclude from; to divide or sepa-
rate into parts.
व्य्-आवृज्य, ind. having separated or divided.

व्यावृत् व्य्-आ-वृत् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. A. (in cer-
tain tenses also P., see rt. 1. वृत्), -वर्तते, -वर्ति-
तुम्, to become separated or singled out from (with

to be split asunder or opened; to turn away from,
become averted, go away, depart; to roll or turn
back, return; to turn round, go round, revolve; to
go down, set (said of the sun); to come to an end,

from (with inst. or abl.); to turn away, turn out, set
aside, exclude, put aside, lay down, remove, take

about, strew; to turn about or round, cause to revolve;
to retract; to exchange, substitute one for another,
to contrive (?) : Pass. of Caus. -वर्त्यते, to be excluded,
&c.: Desid. -वृत्सते, to wish to separate from, &c.

व्य्-आवर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, separating from, ex-
cluding, excepting; turning away from; turning
round; encircling, encompassing.
—व्यावर्तक-ता,
f. state of excluding, exclusion.

व्य्-आवर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to turn away,
made to desist, made to revolve; exchanged.
व्य्-आवर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excluded or excepted.

व्याव्यध् व्य्-आ-व्यध् (वि-आ-), cl. 4. P. -विध्-
यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to throw about; to brandish, wave
about.
व्य्-आविध्य, ind. having brandished or waved about.

व्यासञ्ज् व्य्-आ-सञ्ज् (वि-आ-), cl. 1. P. -सजति,
-सङ्क्तुम्, to attach firmly to, fasten on; to adhere
separately or severally.

व्य्-आसक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, firmly attached to or con-
nected with, adhering closely to (any one or any-
thing), devoted to, intent on, occupied with; inher-
ing separately; detached, disjoined, (in this sense वि
is privative); bewildered, confused.

व्य्-आसङ्ग, अस्, m. excessive attachment, close
adherence, devotion or addiction to, resting or sitting
on; close attachment (of the thoughts), attention,
assiduous application, diligent study; addition; de-
tachment, separation, (in this sense वि is privative);
perplexity, confusion.

व्यासङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, attaching one's self or apply-
ing closely to (anything).

व्य्-आसज्य, ind. having firmly attached or fastened
on, having adhered or inhered separately or severally.
—व्यासज्य-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, inhering in more sub-
jects than one (as a quality &c.).

व्यासिद्ध व्य्-आसिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (see 2. आ-सिद्-
ध), prohibited, forbidden, restrained; contraband
(i. e. not allowed to be sold except to particular
persons or in certain places).
व्य्-आसेध, अस्, m. prohibition, hindrance, restraint.
व्यासुकि व्यासुकि, इस्, m. a proper N.

व्याहन् व्य्-आ-हन् (वि-आ-), cl. 2. P. -हन्ति,

repulse; to foil, disappoint; to impede, obstruct,
delay; to vex: Caus. -घातयति, -यितुम्, to repel,
obstruct.

व्य्-आहन्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being excessively
struck back or repelled, being obstructed.

say, tell, declare, narrate, report; to explain; to
answer; to cry, scream.

व्य्-आहरण, अम्, n. the act of uttering or pro-
nouncing, utterance, pronunciation; speech, narra-
tion, explanation.

व्य्-आहरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, uttering, pronouncing,
speaking; uttering a cry (as an animal).

व्य्-आहर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be told or declared
or mentioned.

व्य्-आहार, अस्, m. utterance, speech, voice; a
word, articulate sound, language; jest, joke, humorous
speech, facetious allusion (a particular Alaṅkāra or
figure in rhetoric).
व्य्-आहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking, saying.

व्य्-आहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken, uttered, pronounced,
said, declared.

nounced after ॐ by every Brāhman in commencing

hṛtis or mystical words (described above).
—व्याहृति-
पूर्वक, अस्, इका, अम्, preceded by the three mystical
